limitations: No cool-pavement candidate is operational without authoritative public paved-surface geometry.
Surface condition, traction, glare, drainage, radiant exposure, and product compatibility require field and engineering review.
Street View vegetation and sky context do not prove that a stop is unshaded or measure useful shade throughout the day.
Right-of-way, utilities, safety, visibility, and constructability require field verification.
Mapped public-site compatibility does not establish planting space, ownership approval, soil condition, irrigation, or utility clearance.
Vegetation and environmental context may influence screening only when verified evidence is available.
